aries:
♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon moves through sidereal Gemini in Ardra nakshatra, activating your 3rd house of courage, skills and daily interactions. This can make you sharper with words, more restless and eager to act quickly. At the same time, exalted Jupiter tightly conjoined with debilitated Mars in Cancer in your 4th stirs deep domestic and emotional currents: old family patterns or living‑space issues want your attention, but there’s also a chance to turn pressure at home into new strength. Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus together in Libra fall in your 7th house of partners and agreements, so people around you are strong catalysts for change.

💼 Career: The busy 3rd‑house Moon favors short tasks: calls, messages, quick decisions, errands, documentation. Yet that Mars–Jupiter combo in your 4th suggests that what happens behind closed doors (home office, family responsibilities, your emotional base) strongly affects professional focus. You might need to juggle a demanding piece of work with a household matter. Sun and two retrograde benefics in your 7th highlight renegotiations—revising contracts, clarifying roles with a client, or revisiting terms with a business partner. You’ll get farther by seeking win–win fairness than by trying to “win” the debate.

❤️ Love: Relationship energy is intense but potentially healing. With Libra lit up in your 7th, you’re pushed to examine how balanced your closest bonds really are. Retrograde Mercury and Venus can revive old conversations about give‑and‑take, respect, or decision‑making. The Gemini Moon in Ardra may make you quicker to speak from irritation, especially if you feel misunderstood. Rather than re‑fighting an old argument, ask, “What structure between us would stop this pattern from repeating?” Single Aries could reconnect with someone from the past or meet a sharp, talkative person through online exchanges or short trips; see whether actions match words before investing emotionally.

💰 Money: With Jupiter and Mars in your 4th, spending or investment around property, housing, vehicles, or family obligations may be on your mind. There can be pressure—an expense you can’t fully ignore—but also a chance to fix something that has long bothered you. Libra planets in your 7th emphasize shared financial promises: profit splits, client retainers, or money tied to partnerships. Retrograde motion favors revising or correcting these more than entering brand‑new deals. The 3rd‑house Moon may generate several small, scattered costs; keep a simple log so you see the pattern rather than feeling vaguely depleted.

🧘 Advice: When your temper spikes, assume it’s pointing to a system that no longer works—for your home, your work, or your relationships. Fix the system instead of attacking the person.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your real power move today isn’t pushing harder; it’s renegotiating the terms under which you push at all.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon travels through sidereal Gemini in Ardra, lighting up your 2nd house of livelihood, values and speech. This brings quick calculations around money and security, but also sharper, more cutting words if you feel provoked. In Cancer, exalted Jupiter and debilitated Mars join in your 3rd house, charging your mind with both confidence and impatience—ideas come fast, and you may want immediate results. Meanwhile Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus (your ruler) in Libra activate your 6th house of work, service and health routines, putting daily habits and obligations under review.

💼 Career: With so much activity in your 6th house, you’re in a strong phase for reorganizing work rather than simply enduring it. Retrograde Mercury invites you to re‑engineer workflows, revise task lists, or fix miscommunications with coworkers. Venus retrograde asks whether you’ve been over‑pleasing or under‑valuing your time. The Gemini Moon in your 2nd encourages you to speak up about compensation or fairness, but Ardra’s rawness can make you blunter than intended—prepare your points, not your anger. Mars–Jupiter in the 3rd favors study, short courses, or learning a practical skill that can improve your career standing.

❤️ Love: Today’s energy pushes you to look at how security and service operate in your relationships. The 2nd‑house Moon can trigger questions like, “Do we treat each other as real assets in each other’s lives?” The Libra cluster in your 6th can bring up dynamics around chores, health support, and daily teamwork with a partner: who does what, who sacrifices what. If you’re partnered, practical changes to how you share responsibilities can feel surprisingly romantic, because they demonstrate care. If single, you may feel drawn to someone reliable in your everyday environment—someone whose consistency, not their drama, stands out.

💰 Money: With the Moon highlighting your 2nd, finances are in the foreground. You may feel the urge to tweak your budget, juggle different income ideas, or chase a side opportunity. Mars–Jupiter in the 3rd can produce bold, enterprising thoughts around sales, marketing or local ventures—but check whether you truly have the time to execute. Libra in the 6th points to expenses or gains linked to work tools, coworkers, or health routines. Retrogrades are perfect for canceling what you don’t use, reviewing benefits, or correcting underbilling or overbilling.

🧘 Advice: Before saying yes to new commitments, ask: “Does this support or strain the systems that keep my life steady?” Let your routines, not your momentary excitement, be the judge.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Real comfort isn’t bought in one big purchase—it’s built from the small agreements you keep with yourself every day.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through your own sidereal sign in Ardra nakshatra, activating your 1st house and amplifying all things Gemini: quick thinking, curiosity, and the temptation to scatter in three directions at once. Ardra adds an emotional storminess below the surface—you may experience intense flashes of insight or mood. Exalted Jupiter with debilitated Mars in Cancer occupy your 2nd house, pushing you to act decisively about resources and self‑worth. Sun, retrograde Mercury (your ruler) and retrograde Venus in Libra light up your 5th house of creativity, joy and romance, turning your attention to what genuinely feels alive in you.

💼 Career: With the Moon in your 1st, others notice your ideas and presence more readily. This is a strong day to take initiative on proposals or problem‑solving, as long as you consciously pace yourself. The Libra emphasis in your 5th favors tasks involving design, storytelling, teaching, or anything that requires a personal touch. Retrograde Mercury invites you to revive or rework an older project rather than chasing a brand‑new shiny concept. Mars–Jupiter in your 2nd can boost confidence to ask for better pay or clearer recognition; combine Jupiter’s wisdom with Mars’ courage by backing your request with solid numbers, not just emotion.

❤️ Love: Romantic energy is vivid. The 5th‑house Libra trio can bring back an old crush, rekindle playfulness with a current partner, or inspire you to express feelings more artistically—through words, music, or gestures. With your Moon in Ardra, though, your emotional weather may change quickly, so avoid ultimatums. If partnered, focus on shared activities that let both of you create or explore rather than dissecting the relationship all day. If single, you may feel drawn toward witty, artistic or charming people; just notice whether you’re filling a boredom gap or responding to genuine connection.

💰 Money: The Mars–Jupiter conjunction in your 2nd can be a powerful mix for finances: Jupiter protects and expands, while Mars wants swift action. This may show up as a push to clear a lingering money issue, increase earnings, or invest in a skill. The key is proportion—avoid swinging from total avoidance to risky overreach. The 5th‑house Libra focus might tempt you toward speculative ventures or spending on fun; retrogrades suggest reviewing prior choices first: what types of “fun” actually left you richer in experience rather than regretful?

🧘 Advice: When your mind is running hot, choose one small thing to finish entirely instead of chasing the next stimulating thought. Completion will ground you more than variety today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your brilliance isn’t in how much you can think about—it’s in what you’re finally willing to follow through on.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, travels through sidereal Gemini in Ardra nakshatra in your 12th house of rest, retreat and the subconscious. This heightens dreams, private thoughts, and sensitivity to subtle undercurrents. In your own sign Cancer, exalted Jupiter sits with debilitated Mars in your 1st house, creating a powerful mix of drive and moral weight: you may feel compelled to take charge of your life direction, but also more aware of the consequences of your actions. Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra energize your 4th house, spotlighting home, family, and emotional foundations.

💼 Career: Even if work demands attention, your inner world is loud. The 12th‑house Moon suggests you might do your best professional thinking away from the noise—step back to strategize rather than forcing extroverted productivity. Jupiter–Mars in your 1st, however, keeps you visible and assertive: others may turn to you for leadership or decisions. Use that influence to set healthier boundaries and saner expectations, not to take on even more. Libra in your 4th can bring conversations or reviews regarding your workspace, home office, or the emotional climate at home that either supports or sabotages your career.

❤️ Love: With the 4th house lit, the question is: do your closest relationships feel like home? Retrograde Mercury and Venus may revive discussions about living arrangements, family involvement, or old emotional hurts. The 12th‑house Moon can make you quieter or more reflective, perhaps needing extra space to process. If partnered, share what’s happening inside rather than simply withdrawing; your partner doesn’t need every detail, just a window into your mood. If single, you might briefly revisit a past connection in memory, dreams, or actual contact; instead of getting pulled back, use it to clarify what “safe and seen” means for you now.

💰 Money: Mars–Jupiter in your 1st can push you to take bold financial steps—asking for better terms, altering your earning strategy, or changing how you present yourself professionally. Because Jupiter magnifies and Mars accelerates, avoid sudden reactive choices. The Libra 4th‑house emphasis may point to expenses or investments related to home, property, or supporting a family member. Retrograde planets suggest adjusting and improving existing arrangements rather than making irreversible commitments. The 12th‑house Moon also nudges you to check “invisible” spending: subscriptions, quiet leaks, or money given to soothe guilt.

🧘 Advice: Give equal respect to your need for retreat and your urge to move forward. A day that includes both private stillness and one decisive outer step will feel best.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: You don’t have to choose between nurturing others and leading your own life—today you’re learning how to do both on kinder terms.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in sidereal Gemini in Ardra nakshatra activates your 11th house of networks, hopes and wider communities, emphasizing friends, groups and future plans. Exalted Jupiter conjoining debilitated Mars in Cancer occupies your 12th house, stirring strong but partly hidden drives—old ambitions, buried frustrations, or spiritual questions may surface. Sun, your ruler, along with retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra energize your 3rd house of communication, siblings, and skills, making this a day where what you say and how you say it reshapes your trajectory.

💼 Career: The 11th‑house Moon favors collaborative projects, professional networking, and long‑range thinking about your place in an industry or community. You may hear news through friends or colleagues that alters your plans. With your 3rd house crowded, writing, speaking, teaching, sales and negotiations are particularly emphasized—but with Mercury and Venus retrograde, it’s about refining and renegotiating more than aggressive expansion. Mars–Jupiter hidden in your 12th warns against working in ways that quietly exhaust you or acting on unspoken resentment. Channel that intense behind‑the‑scenes energy into research, strategy, or closing an old chapter gracefully.

❤️ Love: Social circles and communication patterns are central now. The Moon in your 11th can blur lines between friendship and romance: a friend might start to feel more significant, or your partner’s friends and your own group dynamics may be a topic. Libra in your 3rd supports honest yet diplomatic conversations. Old messages, drafts, or memories may resurface, inviting you to see how your style of speaking has shaped your relationships. If single, you could reconnect with someone via social media or through mutual friends; check if their current reality matches your old impression before diving in.

💰 Money: The 11th house also rules gains, bonuses and long‑term financial goals. The Moon here can bring small opportunities via networks—referrals, collaboration offers, or insight into how others are handling similar financial aims. Mars–Jupiter in the 12th raises the question of what your hidden costs are: stress‑related spending, unacknowledged charitable obligations, or money lost through lack of oversight. Libra planets in the 3rd encourage you to renegotiate deals related to communication work—contracts for writing, teaching, marketing or tech—and to clear misunderstandings around invoices or deliverables.

🧘 Advice: Notice where you play the “hero” quietly behind the scenes without clear agreements. If you’re essential, it’s okay to be explicit about it.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your influence reaches far today—but it becomes sustainable only when your unseen efforts are matched by clear boundaries.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

You may feel both ambitious and emotionally reactive to how others perceive you. Exalted Jupiter conjoined with debilitated Mars in Cancer occupies your 11th house of gains, patrons and networks, charging your long‑term plans with urgency. Sun, your ruler Mercury in retrograde, and retrograde Venus in Libra emphasize your 2nd house of income and self‑worth, making this a day to measure what your efforts are truly yielding.

💼 Career: With the Moon at the top of your chart, professional matters stand out. This can bring recognition or simply more people watching what you do. Ardra’s influence suggests that changes or disruptions at work—reshuffling roles, shifting expectations—may trigger strong feelings, but also clear away something outdated. Mars–Jupiter in your 11th are excellent for strategic networking and goal setting: reach out to people who can actually move a project forward. Libra’s activity in your 2nd house encourages you to review salary, pricing, or how you present your value. Retrograde Mercury supports revisiting old proposals, re‑quoting earlier work, or correcting past undercharging.

❤️ Love: You might be more focused on your role in the world than on romance, but relationship themes still run through practical channels. With the 2nd house lit, partners may discuss budgets, shared priorities, or material plans. If partnered, be honest about what makes you feel respected both emotionally and materially; avoiding the topic doesn’t keep the peace, it just hides resentment. If single, you may feel drawn to people who appreciate your competence and reliability—perhaps someone you meet in professional or financial contexts. Just be aware of mixing mentoring or financial dependence with romance.

💰 Money: This is one of your stronger recent days for financial recalibration. Libra in the 2nd favors fair arrangements in income and spending. Retrograde Mercury and Venus prompt you to check whether your current financial habits actually align with what you say you value. Mars–Jupiter in the 11th could indicate increased gains through community, online ventures, or long‑term investments, but also the temptation to overpromise or overspend in pursuit of status. The 10th‑house Moon may require spending related to career visibility—training, presentation, or tools; choose what clearly supports your next 12 months, not just your next week.

🧘 Advice: When criticism or praise lands today, sort it into two piles: what helps you refine your craft, and what only feeds anxiety. Release the second pile.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your work becomes truly powerful when your sense of worth comes from inner alignment, not shifting external approval.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in sidereal Gemini in Ardra nakshatra activates your 9th house of purpose, higher learning and belief systems, sparking questions about what you really stand for. In Cancer, exalted Jupiter with debilitated Mars occupy your 10th house, making this a high‑pressure, high‑potential time for career shifts and leadership decisions. Meanwhile Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in your own sign illuminate your 1st house, placing your identity and personal direction under a bright, honest spotlight.

💼 Career: With Jupiter and Mars at the top of your chart, important responsibilities or turning points in your public life are likely. Jupiter offers support and visibility, while Mars can bring conflicts, deadlines or assertive moves from you or others. This is a powerful combination for taking a stand about your role—but do so with long‑term consequences in mind, not just today’s emotion. The 9th‑house Moon suggests you may need more meaning in what you do; research new paths, mentors or training that align with your evolving values. Retrograde Mercury and Venus in your 1st are ideal for rebranding, rethinking your professional image, or re‑entering the world on your own terms after a period of compromise.

❤️ Love: With so much energy in your sign, the key relationship today is the one with yourself. Others may mirror back where you have over‑accommodated or, conversely, withdrawn. Ardra’s influence in your 9th can stir debates around beliefs, ethics, or future plans with a partner. If partnered, conversations about where you’re heading as individuals and as a couple are timely—even if they feel intense. If single, you may feel pulled between old relationship patterns and a new, more self‑respecting stance. People who challenge your growth may appear; distinguish between constructive challenge and destabilizing chaos.

💰 Money: Career shifts echo in your finances. Jupiter–Mars in the 10th can bring both opportunities and volatility in earnings linked to your status or leadership. It might be time to reassess whether your current path honors both your bank account and your conscience. With your 1st house lit, consider how your self‑concept influences money choices—is your spending about genuine needs or about maintaining an image? The 9th‑house Moon can highlight costs or gains around education, legal matters, or travel; use this transit to gather information and read fine print rather than locking into heavy commitments.

🧘 Advice: When faced with competing expectations, add this question: “If I weren’t trying to impress or appease anyone, what would I choose?” Let that answer at least enter the conversation.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Today’s recalibrations are not about becoming someone new—they’re about finally standing openly as who you already are.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in sidereal Gemini in Ardra nakshatra passes through your 8th house of depth, shared resources and psychological transformation, stirring complex emotions and a desire to get to the bottom of things. In Cancer, exalted Jupiter conjoined with debilitated Mars energizes your 9th house of beliefs, study and long‑term direction; your convictions and worldview may be undergoing forceful revision. Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra occupy your 12th house, turning part of your energy inward toward healing, closure, and solitude.

💼 Career: Your outer life may not reflect the intensity of your inner processing, but it’s there. The 8th‑house Moon is excellent for research, audits, confidential work, or behind‑the‑scenes negotiations. You may uncover hidden information or see the deeper motives in a situation. Mars–Jupiter in your 9th encourage bold steps in education, publishing, mentoring, or international matters, but Ardra suggests doing so after clearing confusion, not from frustration. Libra in your 12th can bring reevaluation of old workplace relationships or projects; some ties are ready to be released gracefully rather than dragged forward.

❤️ Love: This is a day when you may crave emotional honesty more than surface harmony. The 8th‑house Moon can intensify fears and desires around trust, loyalty and intimacy. If partnered, you might feel compelled to discuss topics usually kept under the rug: power imbalances, resentments, or unspoken expectations. Choose a calm moment, not the peak of a trigger, and frame your words around what you feel and need instead of accusations. If single, you may feel magnetically drawn to someone complex, but Libra planets in your 12th suggest being cautious with people who are unavailable or come wrapped in secrecy or distance.

💰 Money: Shared finances, debts, inheritances, or taxes can come into focus with the Moon in your 8th. It’s a favorable time to update records, clarify who is responsible for what, or tackle paperwork you’ve postponed. Jupiter–Mars in the 9th may relate to significant expenditures or earnings connected with higher education, legal matters, or international dealings. Consider both ethical and practical dimensions before committing. Libra in the 12th can hint at hidden costs or past financial entanglements with others that now need rebalancing; retrogrades help you renegotiate or close them out.

🧘 Advice: When strong emotion rises, treat it like a messenger, not a verdict. Ask what part of you is trying to feel safer, and respond to that need directly.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your transformation today isn’t about burning everything down; it’s about bringing light into the rooms you’ve kept locked.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in sidereal Gemini in Ardra nakshatra activates your 7th house of one‑to‑one relationships, bringing partners, clients and key counterparts to the forefront. Exalted Jupiter, your ruler, tightly conjoined with debilitated Mars in Cancer occupies your 8th house, intensifying matters around vulnerability, shared resources and deep psychological shifts. Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra stimulate your 11th house of friendships, communities and long‑term aspirations, making this a distinctly relational and future‑oriented day.

💼 Career: Work is unlikely to be a solo affair just now. The Moon in your 7th highlights negotiations, collaborations and direct dealings with others. Ardra’s sharp energy can bring frank feedback or sudden clarifications in partnerships, both professional and personal. Jupiter–Mars in your 8th suggest that shared projects involving other people’s money, joint ventures or sensitive data are powerful but require careful handling; impulsive moves could have lasting impact. Libra in your 11th supports reconnecting with former teammates, revisiting old group projects, or realigning your professional networks with your actual ambitions.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes are vivid. The 7th‑house Moon often reflects your own state through the behavior of others; pay attention to what your partner or close contacts mirror back. Ardra can trigger stormy conversations, but also clear the air. If partnered, you may discuss trust, shared plans, or how deeply you’re both willing to invest—emotionally and practically. Jupiter–Mars in the 8th highlight intimacy and fear of loss; approach sensitive topics slowly, without ultimatums. If single, someone intense, possibly from your wider circle or online communities (11th house), could catch your attention; take your time discerning whether the connection is transformative or just dramatic.

💰 Money: With the 8th house and 11th house both active, finances involving others are in focus: investments, loans, salaries tied to team performance, or collective ventures. Jupiter can protect and expand, while Mars may push you to move money quickly; balance enthusiasm with sober risk assessment. The 7th‑house Moon supports making or revisiting financial agreements, but do your due diligence—ask questions you usually avoid. Libra’s retrograde planets in your 11th favor updating contribution levels in groups, renegotiating shared expenses with friends, or refining long‑term savings plans to match your evolving goals.

🧘 Advice: When multiple people pull on your attention, prioritize conversations that clarify commitments over those that only trade opinions.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The alliances that truly support your future are the ones where courage, honesty and responsibility show up on both sides.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

Exalted Jupiter with debilitated Mars in Cancer travels through your 7th house, intensifying relationship dynamics and business partnerships—supportive when handled consciously, draining if left on autopilot. Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra highlight your 10th house of career and public role, signaling a period of professional reassessment and visible adjustments.

Ardra’s energy wants to fix what’s broken rather than gloss over it. Meanwhile, Libra in your 10th puts your reputation and leadership style under review: how you handle fairness, diplomacy, and conflict at work is noticed. Retrograde Mercury suggests revising strategies, renegotiating responsibilities, or revisiting past career decisions with new wisdom. Jupiter–Mars in your 7th can bring powerful allies or strong disagreements; clear contracts and explicit expectations are your best tools.

❤️ Love: Relationships are significant and possibly intense. With Jupiter and Mars in your 7th, partners may lean on you more, or you may lean on them; the balance of power and responsibility becomes a topic. This can be a time of growth together, if you’re willing to address underlying frustrations instead of just managing surface logistics. The 6th‑house Moon reminds you that love lives in daily behaviors: how you show up, help, and communicate around small issues. If single, you may notice potential in someone you work with or deal with regularly; observe how they handle stress and service to others before moving closer.

Retrograde motion favors renegotiating or correcting terms rather than dramatic ultimatums. Jupiter–Mars in the 7th point to joint financial plans, client‑based income, or legal agreements; seek advice if something feels disproportionate. ⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your steadiness is most valuable when you use it to redesign flawed systems, not just to endure them longer.

pisces:
♓ Pisces
